items.title: Chiphersteller - Nvidia-Chef Huang verlässt nach Affären das Unternehmen
items.teaser: Der Chef des amerikanischen Chipherstellers Nvidia, Jensen Huang, tritt wegen einer möglichen Spionageaffäre und dem Bekanntwerden von außerehelichen Beziehungen zurück. items.title: What have the talks with Russia and the US in Abu Dhabi achieved for Ukraine?

items.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Putin beharrt auf Gebietsansprüchen
items.teaser: Bei einem Treffen mit den US-Unterhändlern Witkoff und Kushner hat der russische Präsident Putin seinen Anspruch auf ukrainische Gebiete erneuert. Eine mögliche Beteiligung Europas an Friedensgesprächen schloss er nicht aus.

items.title: Finland to allocate over EUR 37M for Ukraine’s reconstruction

items.title: Finland directs over €30 million to rebuild Ukraine
items.teaser: The Finnish Ministry for Foreign Affairs is contributing funds under the Strategic Investment and Support for Ukraine programme to strengthen critical infrastructure.

items.title: Electric shock, beating, choking — Russian commander tortured civilians in occupied Oleshky, prosecutors say
items.teaser: The Russian soldiers detained two unarmed local residents in June 2023. The civilians endured ten days of torture in dire conditions, deprived of sufficient food, water, and basic sanitation.

items.title: Beyond NATO: How JEF could become a new security alliance for Ukraine
items.teaser: Few stories are as dramatic as Ukraine's long road to NATO membership. But have we ever seriously considered the alternatives?

items.title: EU outlines ‘winter’ assistance for Ukraine
items.teaser: The European Union is mobilizing additional resources through the rescEU mechanism to step up support for Ukraine ahead of the winter season and amid Russian attacks on the country’s critical infrastructure.

items.teaser: Jensen Huang legt sein Amt wegen Affäre mit mutmaßlicher chinesischer Spionin nieder.

items.title: UK hits 10 largest Russian oil producers with massive sanctions
items.teaser: The UK government has introduced a major package of restrictive measures targeting the shadow fleet, coal enterprises and the Kremlin's largest petroleum companies.

items.title: Russian forces strike Zlatopil in Kharkiv region: Enterprise destroyed, people injured
items.teaser: A Russian strike, reportedly involving Banderol missiles, injured a child and a man, caused extensive damage to an enterprise and damaged residential buildings.

items.title: The 161 km/h cap is back on Ukraine’s Starshield links, nearly three weeks after Kyiv got full speed restored
items.teaser: Last time, the cap lasted ten days and nobody in Washington would say who ordered it.

items.teaser: As the U.S., Ukraine and Russia wrap up trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi aimed at ending the war, Russian battlefield losses continue to mount for another week. items.title: Moldova reports arrest of suspect accused of spying for Russia
items.teaser: Moldova's Security and Intelligence Service says the detainee gathered information on state institutions, particularly agencies responsible for national security, on behalf of Russian intelligence.

items.title: Estonia to provide Ukraine with additional €6.5m to prepare for winter
items.teaser: Estonia will provide €4.5 million to deliver locomotives to Ukraine and €2 million to the World Bank's SPUR 2.0 programme, Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna says.

items.title: Russian drones critically damage fat and oil plant in Chernihiv Oblast
items.teaser: A civilian agricultural processing facility in Chernihiv Oblast has halted production after a series of Russian UAV attacks damaged its property and infrastructure.

items.title: As Russia’s jet drones multiply, Czechia could send Ukraine 16 Skyfox jets that are cheaper to fly than F-16s
items.teaser: Aero says Kyiv could use both training and combat versions, but won’t disclose production status or delivery dates.

items.title: Finland reports strike on Russian warship in Baltic Sea
items.teaser: The Finnish military said on Thursday that their forces had detected a “strike” on a Russian warship in the Baltic Sea the previous day, but the security situation in the area remained stable.

items.title: Ukrainian serviceman recruited by Russia's FSB to help kill airborne brigade commander, SBU says
items.teaser: The investigation revealed that the serviceman "attracted the attention" of Russian intelligence while seeking romantic relationships on Telegram dating channels.

items.title: Nvidia-Chef Huang tritt nach Spionageaffäre zurück
items.teaser: Der Chef des weltgrößten Chipkonzerns Nvidia, Jensen Huang, tritt wegen einer Affäre mit einer mutmaßlichen chinesischen Spionin zurück. Seine Aufgaben übernehme vorübergehend die bisherige Finanzchefin Colette Kress, teilte der US-Konzern mit.

items.title: Danish PM concerned over new Starshield disruptions in Ukraine, vows to raise issue with US
items.teaser: Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen says satellite services are essential to European defence and deterrence against Russia, warning that Ukraine and Europe cannot protect their citizens without them.

items.title: Zelensky's Office explains why Putin proposing humanitarian operation in Kostiantynivka
items.teaser: Russia may use a possible humanitarian operation in Kostiantynivka, Donetsk region, to rotate its troops and bring military equipment into the city, as it did in Oleshky.

items.title: Zelensky on Starshield restrictions: Some in US treat our territory as though it were not Ukrainian
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky believes that restrictions on Starshield's operating speed over Ukrainian territory may be linked to decisions by certain U.S. officials who effectively do not recognize these territories as Ukrainian.

items.title: Ireland backs Merz's call for EU-wide financial support for Ukraine
items.teaser: Irish Foreign Minister Helen McEntee says all EU member states should contribute to Ukraine's funding, warning that the financial shortfall will grow substantially next year.

items.title: Moscow youth raids spark mobilization fears as Russia struggles to recruit soldiers
items.teaser: Russian police detained hundreds of young people in Moscow on Nov. 7, handing some of them military summonses, as Russia struggles to recruit enough men for its war against Ukraine. While the raid sparked questions about whether the Kremlin is trying to recruit more soldiers through its crackdown on youth

items.title: Kallas believes she could represent Europe in talks with Russia on war in Ukraine
items.teaser: Kaja Kallas, EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy and Vice-President of the European Commission, has suggested that she could represent Europe in negotiations aimed at ending Russia's war against Ukraine.

items.title: Putin wants to destroy life in Kyiv and other major Ukrainian cities – Zelensky
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has confirmed that during the talks in Abu Dhabi, the Russians did not have a mandate to discuss a ceasefire. Instead, they conveyed that their ruler, Vladimir Putin, wanted to continue striking Ukrainian cities.

items.title: Putin wants Oleshky-type "humanitarian mission" in Kostiantynivka, which Russia falsely claims to control
items.teaser: Vladimir Putin has proposed a so-called humanitarian mission in Kostiantynivka, Donetsk Oblast, similar to the one in Oleshky, falsely claiming that Russian forces control the city.

items.title: Finanzchefin übernimmt: Nvidia-Chef Huang gibt wegen Spionageaffäre seinen Posten auf
items.teaser: Der Tech-Gigant Nvidia ist seinen Chef los. Jensen Huang stolpert über eine Affäre mit einer mutmaßlichen Spionin und tritt zurück. Vorerst wird nun die bisherige Finanzchefin den Konzern führen.

items.title: Homes in ruins and deserted streets: what Russian-occupied Hola Prystan looks like today – video
items.teaser: Russian occupation and the 2023 Kakhovka dam disaster have devastated Hola Prystan, where most buildings are damaged or in ruins and only 45 children remain.

items.title: MEP says North Korea, like Belarus, is helping Russia abduct Ukrainian children
items.teaser: Dutch MEP Thijs Reuten says North Korea and Belarus are involved in Russia's abduction of Ukrainian children and is calling for expanded EU sanctions against those responsible.

items.title: Zelensky urges Europe to pay attention to Russia-US talks on ‘new security system’ in Europe
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has urged European leaders to pay close attention to talks between Russia and the United States on security in Europe.

items.title: EPG-Treffen in Irland: Europa will mit an den Tisch
items.teaser: Kurze Gespräche und viel Diplomatie: Beim Treffen der Europäischen Politischen Gemeinschaft geht es heute um die Nachbereitung der Ukraine-Gespräche in Abu Dhabi und Moskau. Mit dabei: Selenskyj und der US-Sondergesandte Witkoff. Von S. López.

items.title: Merz sees positive signs Russia may be ready for talks involving Europe
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has said that positive signals emerged from the talks in Abu Dhabi, indicating that Russia may be ready to acknowledge the need for European involvement in further negotiations aimed at ending its war against Ukraine.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,616,330 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,150 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Ukraine's Anastasiia Osadchuk wins world amateur chess title
items.teaser: Ukrainian chess player Anastasiia Osadchuk has won a world title in amateur chess.

items.title: Three women injured in Russian drone attack on bus in Zaporizhzhia district
items.teaser: Around 12-15 people were on the bus in the Zaporizhzhia district when the drone hit it. One of those injured is in a serious condition.

items.title: Russia fires Iskanders at Ukraine. A satellite image shows what Ukraine’s missiles left of a building at a Russian plant that makes their parts
items.teaser: The plant in Oryol supplies parts for Russia’s ballistic and cruise missiles, which is why Ukraine has gone after it twice.

items.title: European Parliament calls for Russia's actions against Ukrainian children to be recognised as genocide
items.teaser: The European Parliament has urged EU countries to recognise Russia's deportation of Ukrainian children as genocide, stressing that their return must not be used as a bargaining chip in peace talks.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike five of Russia's largest oil refineries since Oct 30
items.teaser: Since October 30, Ukraine's Defense Forces have struck five of Russia's largest oil refineries: Omsk, Kirishi, Ryazan, Nizhny Novgorod and Yaroslavl.

items.title: Trump promised Americans Russian diesel. Russia doubled its exports, and none of it went to the US
items.teaser: US buyers have refused the cargoes over legal risks, so the extra Russian fuel is going to other markets instead.

items.title: Russian business is shrinking, with nearly twice as many companies folding as starting
items.teaser: The extractive sector saw net growth between January and September 2026, but 208,500 Russian organisations exited the market amid deteriorating economic conditions.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Russia refuses to discuss de-escalation in Black Sea, Putin wants to go on striking energy infrastructure – video
items.teaser: The Ukrainian president says Moscow refused to discuss a halt to attacks on energy infrastructure or reducing hostilities in the Black Sea during two days of Abu Dhabi talks.

items.title: Meeting between Putin and US special envoys Witkoff and Kushner begins at Kremlin
items.teaser: The US envoys arrived in Moscow from Abu Dhabi, where they took part in two days of closed-door trilateral negotiations involving Ukraine, Russia and the US.

items.title: Estonian PM says Costa and Kallas should represent EU in talks with Russia
items.teaser: Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal believes that European Council President Antonio Costa and EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Kaja Kallas should represent Europe in negotiations on ending Russia's war against Ukraine.

items.title: Gespräche in Abu Dhabi: Was haben sie der Ukraine gebracht?
items.teaser: Die ersten trilateralen Gespräche zwischen der Ukraine, den USA und Russland seit neun Monaten endeten mit einer Einigung über einen Gefangenenaustausch. Ist das Ergebnis ein echter Erfolg und ein Schritt zum Frieden?

items.title: Irish PM comments on number of European negotiators in talks with Russia
items.teaser: Irish PM Micheál Martin has said EU leaders will formally discuss Europe's negotiating representation during an informal meeting of the Council of the EU on 13 November.

items.title: Latvian PM backs German chancellor's ultimatum on aid to Ukraine: "It is the perfect strategy"
items.teaser: Latvian PM Andris Kulbergs has called Merz's demand to link the EU's seven-year budget to all states funding Ukraine "the perfect strategy" for European security.

items.title: Russian colonel reportedly killed in car explosion near St. Petersburg
items.teaser: Russian military officials and other figures involved in Moscow's full-scale invasion have previously been targeted in car bombings and other attacks, sometimes in Ukrainian-led operations.

items.title: European Parliament adopts resolution on Ukrainian children under occupation and those deported to Russia
items.teaser: The European Parliament has adopted a resolution entitled "Ukrainian children forcibly deported to Russia or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine."

items.title: Ukraine’s Patriots stand empty, Zelenskyy warns, while Italy, one of its Aster suppliers, says: “We have some to keep for ourselves”
items.teaser: The Asters arm Ukraine’s SAMP/T batteries, which back up its Patriots against Russian ballistic missiles.

items.title: Tsikhanouskaya says Belarus must be included in Russia-Ukraine peace talks
items.teaser: "Without a free and democratic Belarus, there will be no security, neither for Ukraine nor for European countries," Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya said.

items.title: Car catches fire after drone crashes in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district – Klitschko
items.teaser: A passenger car caught fire in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district after a Russian drone crashed.

items.title: Zelensky arrives at European Political Community summit
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has arrived at the European Political Community (EPC) summit in Dublin.

items.title: Ireland wants Ukraine’s final EU clusters open within seven weeks. Hungary still hasn’t said yes
items.teaser: Budapest has raised no new minority-rights demands, Kyiv says, but it has held up the last two clusters since June.

items.title: A second Russian strike on a blaze near Kyiv killed two firefighters, hours before missiles and jet drones hit 17 sites across Ukraine
items.teaser: The firefighters were already at work on the first fire when Russia struck again. The overnight attack that followed hit a Kyiv apartment block and cut power in western Ukraine.

items.title: One killed, seven injured as Russian drone hits apartment building in Kyiv's Solomianskyi district
items.teaser: A Russian drone strike caused a fire in a nine-story residential building in Kyiv's Solomianskyi district.

items.title: Starshield speed restrictions return, hampering efforts to intercept Russian drones, Zelensky says
items.teaser: "Unfortunately, this is helping the Russians kill more Ukrainians and carry out more accurate strikes against Ukraine," President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

items.title: Russia’s officials have a habit of dying suddenly. Now its ambassador to the US is dead at 66 in Moscow after US midterms
items.teaser: The latest death touches the diplomat Moscow had sent to rebuild ties with a Washington it hoped to win over.

items.title: Spain resumes Russian LNG purchases ahead of key deadline, new report reveals
items.teaser: Spain imported 138,000 metric tonnes of Russian liquefied natural gas (LNG) in October despite having phased out imports from Moscow in September, according to a Nov. 12 report by the Center for Research on Energy and Clean Air.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 10, injure 40 across Ukraine over past day, as peace talks end
items.teaser: Russian forces launched Iskander-M/KN-23/S-400 ballistic missiles, Zircon anti-ship missiles, Gerbera, Banderol/Dan-T and 123 long-range attack drones at Ukraine overnight on Nov. 12.

items.title: A fake front line that exists only on Russian state maps is set to grow all winter, ISW expects, after Russia’s envoys carried it to the peace table
items.teaser: Moscow pairs these paper conquests with a demand for whole Ukrainian oblasts, including towns its soldiers have never reached.

items.title: Russian colonel killed by a remote-detonated car bomb a day after Ukrainian drones hit a nearby Baltic port
items.teaser: The officer reportedly served in the air force and air defense army based in St. Petersburg, though no one has tied the two events together.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1722: Russia sends heavier team to Abu Dhabi peace talks, but its negotiators insist on Kremlin’s original war aims
items.teaser: Ukraine reportedly tests air-launched interceptors at the edge of space as Russia’s Oreshnik threat looms.

items.title: Trumps Unterhändler fordern von Putin Beteiligung Europas
items.teaser: Bei den Gesprächen über die Zukunft der Ukraine in Abu Dhabi saßen die Europäer nicht mit am Tisch. Nun besuchen die US-Gesandten Moskau - nach eigenen Worten, um Putin von einer Beteiligung Europas zu überzeugen.

items.title: Over 160 settlements in Rivne Oblast remain without power after overnight Russian attack
items.teaser: Oleksandr Koval has confirmed overnight Russian strikes targeted energy and residential areas in Rivne Oblast, leaving over 160 settlements without electricity.

items.title: Axios: US urges Russia to outline demands and de-escalation steps in new security agreement with Europe
items.teaser: Washington has proposed a new European security agreement under which Moscow would set out its demands and reciprocal de-escalation measures. The US also wants European representatives involved in future Ukraine peace talks.

items.title: Ukraine peace talks: US envoys arrive in Russia to meet with Putin
items.teaser: The US president's son-in-law Jared Kushner and envoy Steve Witkoff are in Russia to meet Vladimir Putin. The expected meeting comes after two days of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi. Follow DW for more.

items.title: One killed and two injured in Russian drone hit on residential building in Kyiv
items.teaser: A woman aged 44 was killed and two people were injured as a Russian drone hit a nine-storey residential building in Kyiv's Solomianskyi district on the morning of 12 November.

items.title: Ukraine peace talks: US envoys meet with Putin at Kremlin
items.teaser: The US president's son-in-law Jared Kushner and envoy Steve Witkoff were in Russia to meet Vladimir Putin. The meeting comes after two days of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi. Follow DW for more.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with Iskander-M, S-400 and Zircon missiles and 123 drones, with strikes recorded at 17 locations
items.teaser: Russia launched ballistic and anti-ship missiles as well as 123 drones against Ukraine overnight. Ukrainian air defences destroyed or jammed 94 missiles and drones, with strikes recorded at 17 locations.

items.title: Car explodes in St Petersburg, killing Russian colonel – video
items.teaser: A Russian serviceman was killed when an explosive device detonated in his car in St Petersburg on 12 November. Russian investigators have opened a murder investigation, while local media outlets identify the victim as a colonel.

items.title: Witkoff, Kushner arrive in Moscow following Ukraine peace talks, Russian state media reports
items.teaser: U.S. envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff arrived in Moscow early Nov. 12, Russian state media reported, following two days of Ukraine peace talks on Nov. 10-11 that failed to produce a meaningful breakthrough.

items.title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,150 over past day
items.teaser: Russia’s total combat losses in its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, from February 24, 2024, to November 12, 2026, have reached approximately 1,616,330 personnel, including 2,150 over the past day.

items.title: Treuetest für die Ukraine
items.teaser: Zwei Tage trifft sich Europa in Dublin. Es geht wieder einmal um die Ukraine. Der Zweifel an der Hilfe wächst. Selenskyj muss auf dem Gipfel kämpfen.

items.title: Woman injured in Russian drone attack on Kherson this morning dies in hospital
items.teaser: A 58-year-old woman sustained severe injuries in a Russian drone attack on Kherson's Korabelnyi district on 12 November. Police have launched a war crime investigation following her death.

items.title: Trump's envoys arrive in Moscow for talks with Putin – video
items.teaser: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have landed in Moscow for talks with Vladimir Putin on issues raised during the Abu Dhabi negotiations, ahead of a planned meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Dublin.

items.title: EU purchases of Russian Yamal LNG rise to over $9 billion in 2026, despite October dip
items.teaser: The European bloc has already paid over one-fifth more for Yamal LNG this year than throughout the entire 2025, according to Urgewald.

items.title: Russia loses 2,150 soldiers and 47 artillery systems over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 2,150 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Russia attacks energy infrastructure facilities and residential areas in Rivne Oblast, leaving parts without power
items.teaser: Russian forces targeted energy infrastructure facilities and residential areas in Rivne Oblast overnight, causing power outages in the Rivne and Sarny districts. Critical infrastructure facilities are switching to generators.

items.title: Russia attacks Khmelnytskyi Oblast energy infrastructure, leaving outages
items.teaser: "As a result of the Russian attack, energy infrastructure was damaged, causing emergency power outages in the Shepetivka district," Khmelnytskyi Oblast Governor Serhii Tiurin said.

items.title: Poland must be present at all key forums where Europe's future is decided – Sybiha
items.teaser: Poland must be present at all key forums where Europe's future is decided – Sybiha Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha believes that the Ukrainian-Polish partnership could become one of the key drivers shaping Europe's new economic and security order.

items.teaser: Die EU-Kommission erarbeitet derzeit gemeinsam mit den EU-Mitgliedstaaten praktische Leitlinien zur Anwendung der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 mit Blick auf die Kontrolle immaterieller Transfers von Dual-Use-Gütern. Die Veröffentlichung ist bis Ende 2026 beabsichtigt.

items.teaser: Die Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für unmittelbare und mittelbare Ausfuhren nach Russland (Anlagen C 6 und C 7) wurden aktualisiert und sind ab sofort auf der BAFA-Internetseite abrufbar.

items.title: Lithuania will provide Ukraine with essential energy equipment – Zelenskyy
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Lithuania has agreed to provide essential energy equipment following talks with President Gitanas Nausėda, as Ukraine prepares for further Russian strikes on its infrastructure.

items.title: Prosecutors seeking to return Pochaiv Lavra complex to state ownership
items.teaser: Prosecutors in Ukraine’s Ternopil region have filed a lawsuit seeking to terminate a 2003 agreement granting the Pochaiv Holy Dormition Lavra complex for free use for more than 50 years and return the property to state ownership.

items.title: Russia attacks Kyiv with ballistic missiles hours after peace talks end
items.teaser: Attacks against the capital are ongoing, and details about precise targets are not yet available.

items.title: NATO says only Ukraine has the right to decide fate of its territories
items.teaser: NATO's Deputy Supreme Allied Commander Europe John Stringer has praised Ukraine's strikes on Russian oil infrastructure facilities and questioned the Kremlin's intentions in peace talks, stressing that territorial decisions belong to Ukrainians.

items.title: Russia's largest oil refinery slammed by drones in 8-hour attack 2,500 km from Ukraine
items.teaser: The Omsk oil refinery, a Gazprom facility in Siberia, has a processing capacity of over 21 million metric tons of crude per year.

items.title: Ukraine's intelligence exposes Russian agents of influence in EU countries
items.teaser: The Defense Intelligence of Ukraine (DIU), in cooperation with the Center for Countering Disinformation (CCD), has published information on Russian agents of influence in European Union countries.

items.title: 1,600 Russians died capturing, then retreating from, one small settlement
items.teaser: A hacked database indicates 1,600 Russian troops died in one tiny village in northern Donetsk. Zelena Dolyna is a bloody symbol of the whole wider war.

items.title: 'Ukraine's future is within the European Union' — Irish PM aims to open all EU negotiation clusters for Kyiv by end of year
items.teaser: "We have opened three negotiating clusters and will do all that we can to ensure that the remaining two are opened before the end of the presidency," Ireland's Prime Minister Micheal Martin said on Nov. 11 alongside President Zelensky.

items.title: Zelenskyy on negotiations: There is currently a "window of opportunity" to achieve results before 2027
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says political changes expected in Europe and already taking place in the US create an opportunity for a breakthrough in negotiations, while ceasefire proposals remain under discussion.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Americans are trying to find "modifications" to Donbas proposals to end war
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Washington is considering different approaches to resolving the territorial dispute over Donbas, but insists that sensitive issues must be settled at leaders’ level.

items.title: Schläger neben Priestern: Polens Präsident marschiert mit radikalen Nationalisten - und brüskiert Tusk
items.teaser: Vier Tage nach dem Anschlag von Krakau ziehen Zehntausende Nationalisten durch Warschau. Die Veranstalter sprechen von mehr als 700.000 Teilnehmern. Premier Tusk lädt den Präsidenten zur Versöhnung ein, doch dessen Palast winkt ab.

items.title: Zelenskyy outlines expectations for meeting with Trump's envoys following their visit to Putin
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy expects Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner to bring Russia's responses on prisoner exchanges, security guarantees and possible ceasefires to their meeting in Dublin on 12 November.

items.title: Russian nighttime attack on Chernihiv sparks fire at private enterprise, damages vehicles
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Chernihiv overnight on November 11, sparking a fire at a private enterprise.

items.title: How Russian-linked organized crime infiltrated Ukraine's law enforcement
items.teaser: Ukraine's latest corruption scandal has exposed an unlikely alliance between organized crime and the law enforcement officials meant to fight it. Two men from the criminal underworld allegedly wielded influence over senior Ukrainian law enforcement officials, paying bribes in exchange for protection for their illicit b

items.title: Four injured in Russian drone attacks on Zhytomyr Oblast
items.teaser: Overnight Russian drone strikes have hit five communities in Zhytomyr Oblast, damaging homes and infrastructure while injuring responding National Police officers in a double-tap strike.

items.title: Jet-powered Geran drones are just the beginning. How Russia is switching to small missiles and what Ukraine can do about it
items.teaser: Ukraine has barely had time to adapt to Russian jet-powered drones, and Russia is already ramping up production of another weapon – small cruise missiles.

items.title: War update: 125 clashes on front line over past day, Kostiantynivka and Pokrovsk sectors remain hottest
items.teaser: Over the past day, November 10, a total of 125 combat engagements between Ukraine’s Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line, with the heaviest enemy attacks reported in the Kostiantynivka and Pokrovsk sectors.

items.title: Selenskyj: In Abu Dhabi wurde Möglichkeit eines Großgefangenenaustauschs erörtert
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte gestern Abend vor Journalisten in Dänemark, dass bei den Gesprächen in Abu Dhabi die Möglichkeit eines großangelegten Gefangenenaustauschs im Format „1.000 gegen 1.000“ oder „1.500 gegen 1.500“ erörtert wurde.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,614,180 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,580 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Drones attack Russia's strategic Ust-Luga port, sparking fire
items.teaser: On the night of Wednesday, November 11, drones struck Ust-Luga, Russia's second-largest port, located near the city of St. Petersburg.

items.title: „Spiegel“: Bundeswehr verbannt chinesische Drohnen und Autos wegen Spionagegefahr
items.teaser: Die Bundeswehr zieht bei chinesischer Technik die Reißleine. Drohnen bleiben am Boden, bestimmte Autos dürfen nicht mehr in Sicherheitsbereiche fahren.

items.title: Two Russian Banderol drone-launched missiles enter Moldova's airspace
items.teaser: Moldova's Defence Ministry says two Russian cruise missiles entered the country's airspace from Odesa Oblast on 11 November before returning to Ukrainian airspace minutes later.

items.title: Weitere hohe Kampfverluste der Russen - 2580 Soldaten am Vortag
items.teaser: Die Gesamtkampfverluste der russischen Besatzungstruppen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 11. November 2026 werden auf etwa 1.614180 (+2580 zum Vortag) getötete und verwundete Invasoren geschätzt.

items.title: Russian army loses another 2,580 personnel, two air defense systems in war against Ukraine
items.teaser: Russia's total estimated combat losses since the beginning of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, through November 11, 2026, have reached approximately 1,614,180 personnel, including 2,580 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Russians attack Ukraine with a missile and 163 drones overnight
items.teaser: Ukrainian air defences destroyed or jammed 144 Russian drones during an overnight attack. Strikes were recorded at 17 locations.

items.title: Air Defense neutralizes 14 Banderol missiles, 130 Russian drones overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 14 Banderol missiles and 130 drones used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine since the evening of November 10.

items.title: In Region Saporischschja 54 Ortschaften beschossen, ein Zivilist getötet, 15 verletzt
items.teaser: Am vergangenen Tag beschossen die russischen Besatzungstruppen 54 Ortschaften in der Region Saporischschja 1107 Mal.

items.title: Kharkiv hit by two consecutive missile strikes
items.teaser: Kharkiv was hit by two consecutive missile strikes targeting the city's Industrialnyi and Saltivskyi districts.

items.title: Russian drones kill 2 municipal workers, injure another in consecutive attacks on Kramatorsk
items.teaser: Honcharenko accused Russian forces of deliberately targeting people responsible for maintaining essential services in the city.

items.title: Zelensky discusses support for Ukraine with Northern European Prime Ministers amid Russian escalation
items.teaser: The President discussed the diplomatic process and support for Ukraine with the prime ministers of Northern European countries against the backdrop of Russia's escalating attacks.

items.title: Six people injured in evening Russian attacks on Zaporizhzhia district
items.teaser: Russian attacks on the Zaporizhzhia district on 10 November left six people injured and caused fires in residential buildings and a shop. Rescue workers freed two women and took them to hospital.

items.title: Kryvyi Rih under massive Russian drone attack: Parts of city without electricity and heating
items.teaser: Kryvyi Rih has come under a massive attack by Russian unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), leaving parts of the city without electricity and heating. Residential buildings, schools, and kindergartens have been damaged.

items.title: Zelensky on front line situation assessments: Putin lives in different reality
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that during today's trilateral negotiations, Russian representatives claimed that Russia had occupied parts of the Donbas that are actually under Ukrainian control. According to him, this demonstrates significant differences in how the battlefield situation is being assessed.

items.title: Europe must appoint representative for peace negotiations by end of November – Zelensky
items.teaser: Europe must decide by the end of November who will represent it in negotiations aimed at ending the war in Ukraine. Ideally, this decision should be made at a meeting in Germany on November 19.

items.title: Russia loses 2,580 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 2,580 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Zelensky presents Northern European partners with plan for getting through winter
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky presented Northern European countries with Ukraine’s winter preparedness plan, which includes additional supplies of diesel fuel and improved protection for bridges.

items.title: Poland says Pentagon green lit for permanent U.S. military base
items.teaser: Poland has received the Pentagon’s "green light" to establish a permanent U.S. military base on its territory.

items.title: EU's Costa keeps Ukraine funding talks on late-November agenda despite Merz appeal
items.teaser: Costa's response indicates plans to "make time for a broad discussion on Ukraine at the upcoming informal European Council in Dublin", but leaves the previously scheduled financing discussions unchanged.

items.title: Situation in 34 settlements in Kherson Oblast is as critical as in Oleshky
items.teaser: Oleksandr Prokudin warns that dozens of settlements along the Dnipro River are struggling with shortages of electricity, gas, water, food and humanitarian aid as winter approaches.

items.title: USA - Drei mutmaßlich vom Iran unterstützte Terror-Helfer angeklagt
items.teaser: In den USA sind drei angeblich vom Iran unterstützte Männer wegen der mutmaßlichen Beteiligung an Terroranschlägen angeklagt worden.

items.title: Russia cannot destroy Kyiv HPP with airstrikes, expert says
items.teaser: The Kyiv Hydroelectric Power Plant (HPP) is a highly robust structure that could not realistically be destroyed even by ten Russian missiles, according to an expert.

items.title: Another tanker carrying Russian diesel changes course en route to U.S. – Bloomberg
items.teaser: A tanker carrying Russian diesel fuel, which briefly listed the United States as its destination, changed course about 400 nautical miles from New York, adding to uncertainty over Russian fuel supplies to the North American market.

items.title: Wie Selenskyj den ersten Verhandlungstag einschätzt
items.teaser: Vertreter der Ukraine und Russlands verhandeln unter US-Vermittlung über eine Beendigung des Krieges. Europäische Staaten sitzen bei den Gesprächen nicht direkt mit am Tisch.

items.title: Ukraine reportedly strikes Ust-Luga Baltic Sea port as drones attack regions across Russia
items.teaser: Ukrainian drones struck the Ust-Luga Baltic Sea port in western Russia's Leningrad Oblast overnight on Nov. 11, monitoring channels reported.

items.title: Russia sends a heavier team to the Abu Dhabi peace talks. Four of its five negotiators are on record insisting on the Kremlin’s original war aims
items.teaser: What looks like a push for a deal is the opposite. Russia negotiates to win its war, not to end it, and nothing the West has done gives it a reason to choose peace.

items.title: Revolutionsgarden Auftraggeber?: Drei Iraner wegen Terrorplänen an britischem Militärstützpunkt angeklagt
items.teaser: US-Ermittler machen drei Iraner für zahlreiche Anschlagspläne in Europa und Kanada verantwortlich. Im Auftrag der Revolutionsgarden sollen sie auch den britischen Luftwaffenstützpunkt Fairford ins Visier genommen haben. Das US-Justizministerium veröffentlicht nun die Anklageschrift.

items.title: Ukrainian Red Cross vehicle damaged in Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia
items.teaser: A vehicle belonging to the Ukrainian Red Cross Society was damaged in a Russian attack in Zaporizhzhia on Monday.

items.title: South Africa notifies launch of safeguard investigation into certain non-wired float glass products
items.teaser: On 11 November 2026, South Africa notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards regarding the initiation on 3 November 2026 of a safeguard investigation into imports of certain non-wired float glass products.

items.title: US Senator tells incoming Congress not to give up on Ukraine, supply air defense
items.teaser: "Attempts to pacify Putin are both fantasy and folly by an American president who seems forever enamored by this autocratic Russian leader who is endlessly playing President Trump for a fool," Sen. Richard Durbin said.

items.title: Ukraine has reportedly tested air-launched interceptors at the edge of space. The missile is the easy part
items.teaser: Such missile defenses in the cold of space could stop Russia's Oreshnik. But that doesn't mean those defenses will be ready any time soon.

items.title: SSU detains Dnipro resident suspected of directing Russian strikes
items.teaser: The Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) counterintelligence has exposed a local woman in Dnipro suspected of directing Russian strikes on fuel and energy infrastructure facilities and logistics centers on orders from Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB).

items.title: Russian agent posing as SSU officer sentenced to 15 years for directing strikes on Ochakiv
items.teaser: A Russian agent who impersonated an SSU officer and directed Russian strikes on Ochakiv, Mykolaiv region, has been sentenced to 15 years in prison.

items.title: Großbritannien - US-Soldat wegen mutmaßlicher Spionage für Russland festgenommen
items.teaser: Die britische Polizei hat einen US-Soldaten wegen des Verdachts der Spionage für Russland festgenommen.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1721: Abu Dhabi talks open with Russia still demanding the rest of Donetsk Oblast
items.teaser: Reuters reports that Ukrainian drone strikes have disrupted 30% of Russia’s oil refining capacity, while Russian strikes cut power in Dnipro and Kamianske and one MP blocked the final vote on Ukraine’s Space Forces.

items.title: US-Justiz klagt angebliche Iran-Helfer wegen Anschlägen an
items.teaser: In den USA werden drei Männer angeklagt. Es geht um Hilfe bei Anschlägen und entsprechenden Plänen - angeblich im Auftrag Teherans. Was legt das Justizministerium ihnen konkret zur Last?

items.title: Prozessauftakt in Aachen - Mann (20) plante Anschlag auf ICE-Fahrgäste
items.teaser: Ein Mann (20) steht jetzt vor Gericht, weil er einen Anschlag auf ICE-Fahrgäste plante.

items.title: Zelensky: Possibility of large-scale prisoner exchange discussed in Abu Dhabi
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that during the talks in Abu Dhabi, the parties discussed the possibility of a large-scale prisoner exchange in a “1,000 for 1,000” or “1,500 for 1,500” format.

items.title: Ukraine strikes drone port at occupied Donetsk Airport
items.teaser: "There should be fewer enemy drones over Ukrainian cities. That's why we are not only intercepting drones that have already been launched, but also destroying the infrastructure from which they are launched," the 412th Brigade of the Unmanned Systems Forces wrote.

items.title: Erster Tag der Ukraine-Gespräche in Abu Dhabi beendet
items.teaser: Erster Tag der Ukraine-Gespräche in Abu Dhabi beendet

items.title: War update: 116 clashes on front line since morning
items.teaser: There have been 116 combat engagements along the front line, with Russian forces making 14 attempts to break through Ukrainian defenses on the Kostiantynivka axis.

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Erster Tag der Ukraine-Gespräche: Keine Ergebnisse, aber Hoffnung für Gefangene
items.teaser: Der erste Tag der Gespräche zwischen Russland und der Ukraine in Abu Dhabi ist ohne offizielles Ergebnis zu Ende gegangen. Medien berichten aber von einem geplanten Gefangenenaustausch. Eine Waffenruhe scheint dagegen in weiter Ferne.

items.title: Ukraine forecast to see temperatures rise to +19°C on Friday – Meteorologist
items.teaser: An atmospheric front associated with a cyclone will move across Ukraine on Wednesday, November 11, bringing rain and sleet, while warmer weather is expected on Friday, November 13.

items.title: 252 MPs backed Ukraine’s Space Forces. One MP stopped the final vote
items.teaser: The Space Forces are intended to counter, among other threats, Russian ballistic missiles. Bezuhla called the initiative a way to “create a couple more general-level positions.”

items.title: Sybiha urges U.S. to speed up delivery of air defense interceptor missiles
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has urged U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio to speed up the delivery of interceptor missiles for Ukraine’s air defense amid intensified Russian attacks on energy infrastructure ahead of winter.

items.title: Spionage-Vorwürfe: US-Soldat in England festgenommen
items.teaser: Ein Angehöriger des US-Militärs ist im Rahmen von Anti-Terror-Ermittlungen in Großbritannien festgenommen worden.

items.title: Russian forces strike southern Odesa region, killing one, injuring another
items.teaser: Russian forces struck the southern part of Odesa region, killing a 69-year-old man and injuring a 70-year-old woman.

items.title: Reuters: Ukrainian drone strikes disrupt 30% of Russia’s oil refining capacity, deepening fuel crisis as Moscow keeps exporting diesel
items.teaser: Recent drone attacks have disrupted nine major Russian refineries, affecting facilities with a combined capacity of around 2.2 million barrels per day.

items.title: Ukraine and Poland to establish joint working groups on drone and counter-drone technologies
items.teaser: Kyiv and Warsaw will establish joint working groups to develop drone and counter-drone technologies. At the same time, the two sides are finalizing arrangements for the transfer of Polish MiG-29 fighter jets to Ukraine in exchange for access to Ukrainian technologies in the field of unmanned systems.

items.title: Kherson Oblast authorities reveal how many people remain in Oleshky
items.teaser: Oleksandr Prokudin says residents lack access to humanitarian aid, while 34 other settlements on the Dnipro’s left bank are in a critical situation.

items.title: Gas supply disruptions possible in Kirovohrad region following Russian strike on critical infrastructure
items.teaser: Residents of the Svitlovodsk community in Kirovohrad region have been warned of possible gas supply disruptions following an enemy strike.

items.title: Streit um EU-Hilfen für Ukraine: Fico kritisiert Merz scharf
items.teaser: Merz fordert mehr Engagement aller EU-Staaten für die Ukraine. Der slowakische Präsident wirft dem Kanzler "Erpressung" vor, die Slowakei und Tschechien lehnen weitere Beiträge ab.

items.title: Ukraine seeks to arrange another evacuation for Oleshky residents, Lubinets says
items.teaser: The office of Ukraine's human rights ombudsman, Dmytro Lubinets, continues to receive calls and inquiries from Oleshky residents.

items.title: Discussion on restoring European security order to continue in Dublin
items.teaser: Following the G7 foreign ministers’ meeting in Paris, discussions on restoring Europe’s security order will continue at the European Political Community summit in Dublin on November 12. Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha expects the summit to adopt a relevant declaration.

items.title: Ukraine war latest: Rubio says security guarantees for Ukraine must also be acceptable to Russia
items.teaser: Key developments on Nov. 10: Security guarantees for Ukraine must also be acceptable to Russia, Rubio says Russia planning strikes on Ukraine's food industry, military intelligence source says Russian forces seek to isolate Zaporizhzhia by striking bridges, dams, Ukrainian commander says Russian companies seek foreign

items.title: Ukrainian air defences down 124 Russian drones and 14 Banderol missiles during day
items.teaser: Russia launched 155 drones and 16 missiles against Ukraine during the day on 10 November. Air defences shot down or jammed 124 UAVs and 14 Banderol/Dan-T missiles.

items.title: Ukrainian air defenses neutralize 124 hostile drones, 14 Bandrol jet-powered munitions
items.teaser: Ukrainian air defenses neutralize 124 hostile drones, 14 Bandrol jet-powered munitions Ukraine’s air defenses have neutralized 124 Russian drones and 14 S8000 Bandrol/Dan-T jet-powered loitering munitions that attacked Ukraine on November 10.

items.title: Drone kills Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant electrician on his way to work, but the IAEA names no attacker
items.teaser: The agency’s record now lists three plant staff deaths since 29 October, one of which is only alleged by Russian officials.

items.title: Sybiha outlines Ukraine’s message at trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi
items.teaser: Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has outlined Ukraine’s key message at trilateral talks with Russia and the United States in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Spionage-Angst in Kasernen - Bundeswehr verbannt Drohnen und Autos aus China
items.teaser: Die Bundeswehr verbietet bestimmte Technik wegen möglicher Spionage.

items.title: One killed and one injured in Russian attack on southern Odesa Oblast
items.teaser: A Russian combined attack on southern Odesa Oblast killed a 69-year-old man at a bus stop, injured a woman, and damaged a residential building and businesses.

items.title: Video message of President António Costa for the New Economy Forum
items.teaser: President of the European Council António Costa delivered a video message on the occasion of the New Economy Forum award, in which he highlighted the important role of the 2026 awarded Ibero-American General Secretariat in promoting multilateralism and international relations.
